stage: Initial source audit before article edits; not a completed translation review
findings: Big-O is an asymptotic upper bound, not automatically a worst-case or tight growth ratio; model and average/expected/worst-case scope must be specified. Polynomial does not guarantee practical feasibility.
Integer magnitude N differs from bit length b=floor(log2N)+1; exact N=2^b is false. Modular arithmetic steps have nonconstant bit costs; constant stored residues are not constant bits.
Two k-bit primes produce a2k-1or2k-bit product, not invariably2k. Need distinct odd primes and exclude e1; exponent d is not whole key.
Factoring suffices for RSA inversion; not all attacks require factoring. Raw arithmetic, OAEP/PSS, authentication and scheme security need separation; no unconditional one-way or timing guarantee.
The smallest prime factor of a composite is at most sqrtN; a largest prime factor can exceed it. Easy huge inputs exist.
Fermat iteration count depends on factor gap and can be Theta(N) for unbalanced factors, not a universal same exponent as sqrtN trial division.
Rho square-root-factor estimate is heuristic/expected under random-function assumptions, not unconditional worst-case; gcdN failure/restart required and nontrivial factor need not be prime.
Quadratic-sieve smooth small signed polynomial values differ from generic Dixon residues; distinguish QS and multiple-polynomial variant. Remove unconditional digit crossover/current fastest claims.
Congruent squares can yield composite nontrivial divisors; require gcd/retry handling, not promise prime factors.
Z[alpha] is not generally the full number-field integer ring; f need not be monic. Need precise scope for algebraic-side factor bases and square-root step.

GNFS complexity is an asymptotic heuristic estimate with o1 term and input/log base specified. Endpoint L equalities and exact O(b^c) need correction; bit-length conversion changes leading exponential constant.
RSA2502020 is a dated example, not a verified current world record.2700core-years are aggregate CPU resource, not a count of simultaneously running computers.

P/NP refer to decision languages; distinguish factoring function from an appropriate decision version and primality. Do not inherit obsolete1996COMPOSITES-not-known-in-P statement; AKS2004 establishes deterministic polynomial primality.

QFT/period finding is not instantaneous or extraction of all parallel answers; exact gate bounds/resource-time forecasts need additional primary verification or removal. No universal PQC guarantee or collapse of all cryptosystems.

Misleading substring links: Japanese CPU clock/block fragments lead to database locks; English Crypto fragments lead to cryptocurrency and NP-complet word split. Linked dependency articles not themselves reviewed.

arithmeticReproductions.scope: Independent public mathematical fixtures; original JA/EN article has no executable code, only2Mermaid blocks. Not cryptographic attacks or an implementation audit.
arithmeticReproductions.bigOUpperNotTight: f(b)=1 belongs to O(2^b), yet f(b+1)/f(b)=1, not2.
arithmeticReproductions.lEndpointCounterexample: b^(c+o1) can be b^c*ln(b), taking o1=lnln(b)/ln(b); ratio to b^c is unbounded.

integerRingCounterexample.scope: Exact rational pair arithmetic for a counterexample; not GNFS implementation.
